label: Fires at D2 after a1 reaches S1, strongest when evidence favoured S2, especially after a1-S2-rewarded.
short_terms: (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action + state == 2) * last_is("a1 S2 r")
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a2 S1 u")
explanation: Silent at D1 and GO. At D2 it fires only when a1 has just led to S1 (common), which is observed at D2. Its size there depends on the previous trial. It is lowest after a1-S1-rewarded (about 0.24) and after a1-S2-unrewarded (about 0), both of which favour S1. It is highest after trials that favour S2 or that were a2: a2-S2-rewarded about 2.9, a2-S1-unrewarded about 2.5, a1-S2-rewarded about 1.8, a2-S1-rewarded about 1.6. So it is large when reaching S1 via a1 goes against recent evidence or follows a switch, and it falls as the observer belief in S1 rises (negative belief_lo weight). The short form keeps the a1-S1 gate, a graded belief_lo term and the single biggest pattern (a1-S2-rewarded). It scores 0.44 on test against 0.56 for the free fit (79%, just under the 80% bar). The free fit, a full table over the previous-trial pattern, adds the a2-preceded cases. Repeated a1-S1-rewarded streaks inside some episodes sit at about 2 and are under-predicted, so episode-level state not captured here also matters.
